## Testing

<!-- Commands you ran and anything you checked by hand. -->

- [ ] `flutter analyze` (app changes)
- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test`
- [ ] `cd website && npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `cd website && npm run lint`
- [ ] `cd website && npm run build`

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one logical fix or feature.
- [ ] No API keys, `.env` files, keystores or downloaded media are included.
- [ ] New UI works at 360px wide and on desktop.
- [ ] Related issues are linked with `Fixes #…`.
